video_title: Lou Williams On His Sixth Man Legacy & Being Snubbed From The All-Star Game

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on his legacy as an all-time sixth man
quotes.excerpt: I put myself first and I think it's appropriate for all three of us to all feel like we're the best.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: So you've made a career of six-man, you've won the award three times. Where do you rank yourself as one of the all-time six-men in the history of the game?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Well, obviously in the conversation. I put myself first and I saw Jamal on here and I think it's appropriate for all three of us, Manu included, to all feel like we're the best. I think that's fair.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I think Manu started too many games though.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: And he's to come in at the 10-minute mark. That's another thing. He's to come in at the 10-minute mark in the first quarter, ladies and gentlemen. We've seen enough from Manu.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on being snubbed from the All-Star game
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I got robbed twice. My last year with the Sixers, I let that team in scoring.
quotes.quote: I feel like I got robbed twice. My last year with the Sixers, I let that team in scoring. We snuck into the playoff situation at that time. It was no play-in at that time, so it was a six seed. I let that team in scoring and I thought that was the first opportunity that I had to be an All-Star that got robbed from me. Doug Collins, who was the head coach at that time, he called me and said, 'Hey, we think it'll be better for our team moving forward. I'm going to call these coaches and I'm going to rally around Andre Iguodala to be an All-Star because we think it'll take our team further if he's the guy that represents us.' To Dre's credit, he was the best player on our team and he was promoted as such. I didn't have an issue with him doing that for Andre. I had an issue with him taking that opportunity away from me, and I felt like I earned it.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on his second All-Star snub with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: I was averaging about 22, 23 a game off the bench and I didn't make it.
quotes.quote: The second one was maybe my second sixth man with the Clippers, that I was averaging about 22, 23 a game off the bench and I didn't make it. I didn't make it then and it was kind of an uproar about me not making the All-Star game and I think Jimmy Butler got in at that last spot. He had some injuries and then he ended up sitting out of the game and I didn't get the reserve spot either. Those two times I felt like would have really put me in a different conversation when it comes to sixth men.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on embracing the sixth man role
quotes.excerpt: Probably when I won my first one in Toronto. I was fighting for my career when I won my first sixth man.
quotes.quote: Probably when I won my first one in Toronto. I was fighting for my career when I won my first sixth man. I had torn my ACL two seasons before that, fought to get back on my feet, fought to get back, and I was in my 12th year. Now mind you, I'd been on the bench a long time before that, but that's when I embraced it, when I thought, okay, this was late in the game for me. Because before that, I was just like, look, I'm just going to make it embarrassing that I'm even coming off the bench. I'm just going to feel, and I'm going to let everybody else talk about it.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Doc Rivers' role in his sixth man success
quotes.excerpt: Doc Rivers was the first guy to do that. It actually got to the point where me and him would have conversations.
quotes.quote: Doc Rivers was the first guy to do that. It actually got to the point where me and him would have conversations like, 'Bro, I really don't want to start you anymore because you're so good coming off the bench.' It gave me an opportunity to win the Sixth Man of the Year because that's your that's your lane.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on losing Sixth Man of the Year voting
quotes.excerpt: I've lost more sixth man than I've won. I've came in second four times.
quotes.quote: I've lost more sixth man than I've won. I've came in second four times. I've lost to James Harden, I've lost to J.R. Smith, and then I lost to Eric Gordon, and I lost to Trez, my teammate. I've lost twice to two of my teammates.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on learning from AI, Kobe, and Kawhi
quotes.excerpt: Different styles of preparation. AI for me, I was so young and my mind was so impressionable.
quotes.quote: Different styles of preparation. AI for me, I was so young and my mind was so impressionable that I just I used to look at him with the biggest eyes like, how you get away with that? It got to the point, man, I trained one day, AI went was was going off and both of y'all been superstars, so y'all y'all know how y'all get from time to time when y'all don't feel like shit is right. Y'all can start tripping a little bit. And so AI going on one of his he going on one of his tangents and I'm just looking at him, I'm looking at him and Mo Cheeks argue back and forth. I'm literally like this, ping pong, looking at them argue. And soon as they got done, trainer said, 'Hey, come here.' He said, 'Hey, I see that look on your face. Just know, them his rules. They not for everybody else.'

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Kawhi Leonard's methodical approach
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi just a silent assassin, one of them guys that, you know, you pull up, he already been in the gym.
quotes.quote: Kawhi just a silent assassin, one of them guys that, you know, you pull up, he already been in the gym an hour and a half, two hours before everybody. He's getting his work in, he's methodical about his approach, sure about what he brings to the table, so he's not really wavering when people got anything to say or or suggestions that how he should go about things. He was he was sure about it and so that was that was interesting to watch.
